entries.en: to obey with reverence; reverent compliance
entries.notes: 汉字第二字存疑（俊/逡），“恭谨遵从”依西语词头 obedecer con reverencia 判定。

entries.zh: 遵命；听从吩咐、依命而行
entries.en: to obey orders; to comply with a command (Sp. head: obey the PP., i.e. the fathers)
entries.notes: 西语缩写 P.p. 展开作 padres（神父）系推断。

entries.en: filial devotion; dutiful heart toward one's parents
filial obedience; dutiful and submissive to one's parents

entries.zh: 夫唱妇随；妻随夫命、妇人顺从丈夫
entries.en: 'the husband sings and the wife follows' — the wife obeys her husband; wifely submission

entries.zh: 平治；平定而治（如“平治天下”）
entries.en: to pacify and govern; to bring peace and order (to the realm)
entries.notes: 西语词头行末断词“amd-”不完整，释义依汉字“平治”与闽南音 pēng ty 判定。

entries.en: ought; it behooves; it is fitting (there is an obligation)
ought; must; should
ought; should (as what is proper)

entries.zh: 任；承担、担当（义务或职事）
entries.en: to bear, undertake (an obligation or an office)
entries.notes: 汉字存疑（任/心），依闽南音 xīm（dzim⁵）判为“任”。

entries.en: ought to be so; it is naturally due
entries.notes: 汉字栏仅“然”而闽南音栏作 cāy xiēn（該然），官话栏 damaetta / pīt xīn 未确解，释义按“該然”推断。

entries.en: ought; should; it is obligatory
one's (proper) duty; one's bounden part

entries.zh: 省人事；省察、明晓人事（首字存疑，或作“生”）
entries.en: to attend to or be versed in human affairs (first character uncertain)
entries.notes: 首字形存疑（省/生），义项“省察人事”系依字面推断。

entries.zh: 任事；任职办事、承担事务
entries.en: to take charge of affairs; to hold office and act
to fulfil one's duty or office

entries.zh: 然该；依理应当如此（犹“该然”）
entries.en: ought as due; it should be so
entries.notes: “然該”词序罕见，释义按“該然／理应”推断。

entries.en: ought; should; must

entries.zh: 合得；相宜、合于应当（犹“合当”）
entries.en: it is fitting or proper; meets what is due

entries.zh: 合该着；务必应当、必须如此
entries.en: one really ought to; must (emphatic 'ought', with modal 著/着)

entries.zh: 缚定；缚紧固定，喻受义务束缚
entries.en: to bind fast, tie firmly — hence bound (by an obligation)
entries.notes: 官话栏 pag hang 与“缚定”对音不合，释义依汉字与闽南音 pag tia。

entries.zh: 感动；打动人心（西语 obligar 此处取“使人心受感”义）
entries.en: to move (someone's heart); to touch or sway a person (cf. Sp. obligar 'to oblige, move')
entries.notes: 闽南音栏三音节 cam tōng moūn 较“感動”多出 moūn 一节未对应汉字；obligar/concertar 与“感动”之对应系推断。

entries.en: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: 仅存西语词头 obligar con buenas obras（以善行施恩结好），汉、音、官话三栏皆空，依纪律不作定释。
